name: Senior Recruiter Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 177 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.7069 x 0.7108 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.7069 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 293.8 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle 0.7 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-cap-senior-recruiter-ribbon-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/recruiter.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js recruiter --write
source_raster: vanguardmil.com product civil-air-patrol-senior-recruiter-miniature-medal (civil air patrol senior recruiter miniature medal), 600 x 600 px, measurement reference only

source_product.title: civil air patrol senior recruiter miniature medal
source_product.note: measurement reference only: never shipped, never committed

measured.photo: senior-recruiter.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: the pebbled (matte) ground of the lettering band and the worn, mottled field of the big star are texture; the band is drawn as flat ground and the star field as one mid tone (the top point is darker than the other four in the photograph: drawn as a second, darker tone)
the five-point lobes of the small stars are plump and their centres are dimmer; each star is drawn as a solid star with a small dimple (hole of r 0.0038 in), nothing finer

letter A of AIR: it merges with pebbles of the ground in the photograph (one component 23 degrees wide); its centre and width (-15.8, 12.4 degrees) are estimated from the strip, not from a clean component; the P-A-T-R-O-L letters are narrower in the photograph than the skeleton font and are fitted by width

EDGE-RECALL GATE NOT MET (0.728 at 0.012 in, needs 0.80; precision 0.995): the pebbled ground of the lettering band gives the photograph's lit-metal outline hundreds of small pebble contours that no designed shape can match; recall by region: inside r 0.2 0.927, top lettering arcs 0.93 to 0.96, bottom lettering arc 0.74 (pebbles beside the letters), the two pebbled sides of the band (70 to 110 and 250 to 290 deg) 0.18; no stipple was invented to raise it
the star carries a thin inner bevel line along its edges that the photograph shows only as a blur; it is not drawn
frame.js disc fit is biased by the photograph cutting the disc bottom (see FRAME NOTE); the rim-ridge circle fit is used instead
ring: cut by the ribbon over its upper half, centre (0.020 in right of the bail axis) and radius fitted to the visible arcs only; the bail is the shared barrel with the shared shading
engraving grain, specular highlights and dark pits of the cast metal are not drawn (flat tones)

palette.ramp: ramp measured from the reference metal (ramp.js)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from senior-recruiter.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Silver miniature: CIVIL AIR PATROL / RECRUITING around a ring of 15 small stars and a large five-point star carrying an R in a medallion. Low-contrast photograph; the star field and the pebbled band are flat in the model. Hang angle 0.7 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
